{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the cleaned data
df_clean = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df_clean['revenue_clean'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove the 6 QA rows with revenue = 999999.99
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

df_clean = df_clean.drop(columns=['revenue_clean'])

# Now, check the cross-tabulation between channel and converted
print('Cross-tabulation of channel vs converted:')
print(pd.crosstab(df_clean['channel'], df_clean['converted']))

# Check: are there any refunded orders with converted=1?
print('Any converted=1 and status=refunded?', (df_clean['converted'] == 1) & (df_clean['status'] == 'refunded')).any()"}
